description: This file is a Cypress configuration script (cypress.config.js) for testing the OrangeHRM application. It sets various Cypress options and defines node event handlers to facilitate database state management through custom tasks like creating savepoints, restoring, truncating tables, and resetting the database.

methods.name: asyncWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a promise to catch errors and return a tuple with result and error.

methods.name: createSavePoint
methods.description: Creates a database savepoint via an API call.

methods.name: restoreToSavePoint
methods.description: Restores the database to a specified savepoint via an API call.

methods.name: deleteSavePoints
methods.description: Deletes specified savepoints from the system via an API call.

methods.name: resetDatabase
methods.description: Resets the database to a fresh state via an API call.

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Truncates data from specified tables via an API call.
